name: entity-chip
title: Entity Chip
summary: A person, team or company named inline, with its monogram.
description: A person, team or company named inline, with its monogram. Monogram (our avatar) + name in a soft field pill. Names a supplier, person or record inside running text. A name longer than the container truncates at the end; the root carries the full name as its title. The name reads in its own direction (unicode-bidi: plaintext), so a right-to-left name or a signed value stays intact on either page.

anatomy.description: Holds the monogram, our Avatar (16px, round, aria-hidden, initials only), then the name. Sets the avatar's default fill to the orange token
Truncates at the end; unicode-bidi: plaintext

color.description: Any CSS color for the monogram (the avatar's color); defaults to the orange token.

monogram.description: Glyph in the disc; defaults to the first grapheme of the name, upper-cased (so emoji and accented letters survive).

notes: The monogram (our avatar) is aria-hidden; the name is the text.
The root's title exposes the full name when it is truncated.
